notes.title: The End is Nigh Update!
notes.content:
We’ve literally ripped the guts out of the original version…. 
[list]
[*] New gameplay mechanic – no more instant death! Use your zombies like ammo to smash through obstacles and defences
[*] Military presence – Riflemen, Rocket launchers, Laser Turrets and Buzz Saw stations….
[*] Level layouts & new levels – We’ve tweaked all the levels to make for a more jam packed, brain filled experience
[*] New Perks added
[*] Achievements updated
[/list]

notes.title: Zombie Control Update
notes.content: Following our recent reviews we have edited the game controls to be more responsive.
